functions.name: Play
functions.docs: Start playback forwards from the current time cursor position, using the current play rate.

functions.name: PlayReverse
functions.docs: Reverse playback.

functions.name: ChangePlaybackDirection
functions.docs: Changes the direction of playback (go in reverse if it was going forward, or vice versa)

functions.name: PlayLooping
functions.docs:
Start playback from the current time cursor position, looping the specified number of times.
@param NumLoops - The number of loops to play. -1 indicates infinite looping.

functions.name: Pause
functions.docs: Pause playback.

functions.name: Scrub
functions.docs: Scrub playback.

functions.name: Stop
functions.docs: Stop playback and move the cursor to the end (or start, for reversed playback) of the sequence.

functions.name: StopAtCurrentTime
functions.docs: Stop playback without moving the cursor.

functions.name: GoToEndAndStop
functions.docs: Go to end and stop.

functions.name: GetCurrentTime
functions.docs:
Get the current playback position
@return The current playback position

functions.name: GetDuration
functions.docs: Get the total duration of the sequence

functions.name: GetFrameDuration
functions.docs: Get this sequence's duration in frames

functions.name: GetFrameRate
functions.docs: Get this sequence's display rate.

functions.name: SetFrameRate
functions.docs: Set the frame-rate that this player should play with, making all frame numbers in the specified time-space

functions.name: GetStartTime
functions.docs: Get the offset within the level sequence to start playing

functions.name: GetEndTime
functions.docs: Get the offset within the level sequence to finish playing

functions.name: SetWeight
RemoveWeight
functions.docs: Removes a previously assigned weight

functions.name: SetWeight
RemoveWeight
functions.docs: Removes a previously assigned weight

functions.name: SetFrameRange
functions.signature: SetFrameRange(Target, Start Frame, Duration, Sub Frames)

functions.name: SetTimeRange
PlayTo
functions.signature: PlayTo(Target, Playback Params, Play To Params)
functions.docs:
Play from the current position to the requested position and pause. If requested position is before the current position,
playback will be reversed. Playback to the requested position will be cancelled if Stop() or Pause() is invoked during this
playback.
@param PlaybackParams The position settings (ie. the position to play to)

functions.name: SetPlaybackPosition
RestoreState
functions.docs: Restore any changes made by this player to their original state

functions.name: SetCompletionModeOverride
functions.docs: Set the state of the completion mode override. Note, setting the state to force restore state will only take effect if the sequence hasn't started playing

functions.name: GetCompletionModeOverride
functions.docs: Get the state of the completion mode override

functions.name: IsPlaying
functions.docs: Check whether the sequence is actively playing.

functions.name: IsPaused
functions.docs: Check whether the sequence is paused.

functions.name: IsReversed
functions.docs: Check whether playback is reversed.

functions.name: GetPlayRate
functions.docs: Get the playback rate of this player.

functions.name: SetPlayRate
functions.docs:
Set the playback rate of this player. Negative values will play the animation in reverse.
@param PlayRate - The new rate of playback for the animation.

functions.name: GetHideHud
functions.docs: Get if the hud is hidden during play.

functions.name: SetHideHud
functions.docs:
Set if hiding the hud during play.
@param HideHud - The new value of Hide Hud during play.

functions.name: SetDisableCameraCuts
functions.docs: Set whether to disable camera cuts

functions.name: GetDisableCameraCuts
functions.docs: Set whether to disable camera cuts

functions.name: GetObjectBindings
functions.docs: Get the object bindings for the requested object

functions.name: RequestInvalidateBinding
functions.docs: Invalidates the given binding, forcing it to be refetched. This may be useful for some custom bindings that wish their resolution code to be called again.

functions.name: GetSequence
functions.docs:
Access the sequence this player is playing
@return the sequence currently assigned to this player

functions.name: RPC_ExplicitServerUpdateEvent
functions.signature: RPC_ExplicitServerUpdateEvent(Target, Method, Relevant Time, New Serial Number)
functions.docs: Called on the server whenever an explicit change in time has occurred through one of the (Play|Jump|Scrub)To methods

functions.name: RPC_OnStopEvent
functions.signature: RPC_OnStopEvent(Target, Stopped Time, New Serial Number)
functions.docs: Called on the server when Stop() is called in order to differentiate Stops from Pauses.

functions.name: RPC_OnFinishPlaybackEvent
functions.signature: RPC_OnFinishPlaybackEvent(Target, Stopped Time, New Serial Number)
functions.docs: Called on the server when playback has reached the end. Could lead to stopping or pausing.
